answer: To resist sybil attacks, an agent economy can require each participant to post a bonded stake as an anchor tied to a verifiable identity, making fake accounts costly rather than free. Reputation then flows like nectar through attested peer reviews, so new identities cannot harvest trust without sustained contribution, while a gale of collusive registrations is throttled. Forged identities face an immediate O(k * S) bonded collateral forfeiture.
